title: AI Founder Archetype Quiz
description: A quiz that labels founders as categories like Distribution Demon, Infra Monk, Demo Goblin, Enterprise Therapist.

title: Am I Underpaid
description: Drop your role, city, and rate and get a percentile card against live market data: you charge less than 78% of React freelancers in Bangalore. Every anonymous submission sharpens the pool, and the card ends with the one number to quote in your next negotiation.

title: Brainrot Rehab
description: Forward your screen time screenshot and the memes you cannot stop quoting; it stages your brainrot from 1 to 4, then runs your public detox: daily check-ins, a clean-streak badge that updates itself, and a relapse confession card when you fold at 1am.

title: Cold Email Rewrite Desk
description: Paste bad sales email. Hermes rewrites it for a specific buyer and creates 3 follow-ups.

title: Fine Print Rage Meter
description: Users paste any terms of service or privacy policy and get the five most outrageous clauses translated into plain English with a 0 to 100 rage score.

title: Founder Investor Update Writer
description: Founders paste metrics and notes. Hermes writes investor update, asks, risks, and next month plan.

title: Google Review Reply Desk
description: Small businesses paste their Google reviews. Hermes drafts replies, apology notes, and recovery offers.

title: Haggle Score
description: A chat game where you haggle with an AI bazaar shopkeeper over a real item and get a shareable Haggle Score card with a beat-my-price challenge link.

title: Latte Into Lambo
description: Users paste a past purchase and its date, like 'iPhone 13, Sept 2021', and get a card showing what that money would be worth today in NVDA, BTC, or an index fund.

title: Market Mood Cards
description: A daily market briefing rendered as one beautiful shareable card: index moves, the three stories that actually moved prices, and one contrarian read, generated as a PNG and pushed to Telegram and WhatsApp channels before market open.

title: Meet in the Middle
description: A WhatsApp bot that ends the where-do-we-meet thread: everyone in the group drops a location pin, it computes the fair midpoint and pitches three venues with honest reasons, and the group votes right in chat.

title: NPC Mode
description: Go NPC for a day: your agent makes every decision, what to eat, when to work, whether to reply to that text, delivered as Telegram prompts you simply obey. Your day streams to a public NPC Mode log page, and you end with a recap card scoring your obedience.

title: Pocket CRM
description: A WhatsApp-native CRM for freelancers: text it after every call, like met Priya, wants a logo, follow up Tuesday. The agent maintains the pipeline, nudges you before deals go cold, and drafts the follow-up message for each stale lead.

title: Real Estate Listing Optimizer
description: Brokers paste property details. Hermes creates premium listing copy, WhatsApp messages, photo checklist, and buyer FAQ.

title: Roast My Landing Page
description: A public URL where founders paste a site and get a brutal, funny, useful teardown with share cards.

title: Startup Idea Dating Profile
description: Turn any startup idea into a dating profile: green flags, red flags, toxic traits, best match customers.

title: X Profile Autopsy
description: Paste an X profile and get a persona card, content gaps, best next 10 posts, and shareable score.
